prompt: This is a plain SvelteKit app on Cloudflare. The cairn engine package is already in node_modules (you can't reach the npm registry from here), but none of cairn's setup is done yet. Add cairn to it and move our old Jekyll posts from old-content/posts into it as cairn posts. Keep each post's title, its date, its summary as the description, and its tags, and keep the unpublished post hidden. Don't set up the admin, GitHub, or sign-in yet, and when you're done tell me what's still a placeholder or left to wire before it can go live. It's done when the site type-checks, the production build passes with every migrated post valid, and each post is served at its own address.
source: src/lib/vite/internal.ts:57,263 cairnManifest: the committed manifest defaults to /src/content/.cairn/index.json and a build on a stale one fails; the plugin's content option maps each concept to its glob

expectations: vite.config.ts gains the cairnManifest plugin (configModule and a posts content glob) and ssr.noExternal for @glw907/cairn-cms; src/app.d.ts imports @glw907/cairn-cms/ambient.

A site config and an adapter module declare a posts concept whose fields include title, date, description, a boolean draft, and a multiselect marked taxonomy: true, so the migrated keys survive the first admin save.
A content module passes the posts glob to createSiteIndexes with validation left on, and a prerendered [...path] route built on createPublicRoutes serves each post at /posts/<slug>.

The four old files become src/content/posts/2023-11-02-first-snow.md, 2024-01-19-pack-list.md, 2024-03-12-winter-gear-guide.md, and 2024-04-02-draft-trip.md: lowercase hyphenated ids, no layout key, the summary as description, tags as slugs, the unpublished post as draft: true, and the winter post dated 2024-03-12 and not 2024-03-13.
The committed manifest (src/content/.cairn/index.json and site-facts.json) is written by cairn-manifest after the migration, and npm run build passes.
